title: Golden CI: share compilation artifacts with java job to avoid redundant build
description:
The golden CI job compiles the entire project from scratch via compile_project() inside the pytest xmage_server fixture (~159s). Meanwhile, the java job already runs `mvn compile -q -T 1C` (~2 min) in parallel. There's no artifact sharing between them, so compilation happens twice.

Options:
- Use GitHub Actions `actions/cache` to share Maven target/ directories between jobs
- Make the golden job depend on the java job and download compiled artifacts
- Use a shared build step that uploads artifacts for both consumers

This is the easiest win — pure CI config change, no Java or Python modifications needed.

Evidence from 3 recent CI runs:
- Run 22524763758: compilation=159.3s (23.4% of 705s total)
- Run 22517711462: compilation ~160s (similar proportion of 722s total)
- Run 22524555497: compilation ~160s (similar proportion of 721s total)

Expected savings: ~150s (~2.5 min).
